source.change: Bounded cache of compatible VkPipeline objects, keyed by SPIR-V, vertex layout, raster state, texture binding indices, and render-pass compatibility.

android_renderer_core.scope: renderer static library only; no Android plugin or APK was produced from this cache change

checks.renderer_regression: Repeated identical draws produced identical readback with the cached pipelines. Updating an R8 video plane produced the same readback as an uncached submission and differed from the previous plane output.

limitations: The pipeline-cache regression uses synthetic draw input, not a retail capture.
No retail performance measurement or full-scene parity claim is made.
No Android APK was rebuilt or installed; the live phone app and window were left untouched.
